feat: add --explain subcommand backed by embedded lint doc pages

Adds a new --explain <LINT_NAME> flag to cargo cost-lint that prints
a lint's full documentation (what it does, why it's expensive, suggested fix)
by embedding the markdown doc pages at build time. Exits 0 without running
a lint pass.

Design decision: docs are embedded at build time via build.rs reading
docs/lints/*.md and generating raw string literals. This ensures the
CLI output and the doc pages share a single source of truth.

Build.rs now panics if a registered lint has no corresponding doc file,
enforcing docs-for-lints at build time before CI ever runs a test.

Created docs/lints/unbounded_input_loop.md because that lint was
registered but missing its documentation page.

Closes #103
